    "Lacked robust features for invoice management",
    "Required workarounds or external tools for detailed financial tracking",
    "Notifications could be overwhelming at times"
  ],
  "overall_experience": "The human resources manager found Basecamp to be a decent tool for basic file sharing and team communication within their small telecommunications company. While it was easy to use for general collaboration, its functionality for managing invoices directly was limited, often requiring them to use other software or manual processes. Despite these limitations, they appreciated its simplicity and value for money."
